definitions.name: O1A.RLE
definitions.body: G0D.RUNS [ 'O1A.RR' BIND O1A.RR 0 GET O1A.RR LENGTH 2 COLLECT ] MAP
definitions.note: numeric V -> Vector of [ value count ] pairs, one per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: O1A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'O1A.UV' BIND O1A.UV O1A.UV G0D.SHIFT GT 0 [ 'O1A.UB' BIND 'O1A.UA' BIND O1A.UA 1 ADD 1 O1A.UB SELECT ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: numeric V -> length of the longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: O1A.DEDUPE
definitions.note: numeric V -> V with each run of equal adjacent values collapsed to one

definitions.name: O1A.SECOND-MAX
definitions.note: numeric V -> second-largest distinct value, NIL when all equal

definitions.name: O1A.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'O1A.MV' BIND O1A.MV LENGTH 'O1A.MN' BIND O1A.MV TALLY 'O1A.MT' BIND O1A.MT KEYS O1A.MT VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 2 MUL O1A.MN GT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
definitions.note: V -> the value occupying more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: O1A.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'O1A.CN' BIND O1A.CN 1 COLLECT 1 150 RANGE O1A.CN [ 'O1A.CE' BIND G0B.COLSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT [ 1 GT ] FILTER LENGTH
definitions.note: positive integer (<= ~100) -> number of Collatz steps to reach 1

definitions.name: O1A.DIGROOT
definitions.body: 1 SUB 'O1A.DR' BIND O1A.DR O1A.DR 9 DIV FLOOR 9 MUL SUB 1 ADD

definitions.name: O1A.FIBIDX
definitions.body: 'O1A.FN' BIND 1 30 RANGE [ 0 1 ] [ 'O1A.FE' BIND 'O1A.FP' BIND O1A.FP 1 GET O1A.FP 0 GET O1A.FP 1 GET ADD 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 0 GET ] MAP [ O1A.FN LT ] FILTER LENGTH 1 ADD
definitions.note: positive integer n (<= F(30)) -> smallest k with Fibonacci F(k) >= n

definitions.name: O1A.BDEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'O1A.DC' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD O1A.DC GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD 0 MAX ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest number of brackets open at once (stray closers close nothing)

definitions.name: O1A.BPREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN 'O1A.BV' BIND [ '#' ] O1A.BV CONCAT [ '#' EQ ] MAP 'O1A.BB' BIND 0 O1A.BB LENGTH 1 SUB RANGE 0 O1A.BB SELECT 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: O1A.PRESENT
definitions.note: V with NILs -> the present elements, in order

definitions.name: O1A.PMEAN
definitions.body: O1A.PRESENT 'O1A.PM' BIND O1A.PM 0 [ ADD ] FOLD O1A.PM LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: V with NILs -> exact mean of the present elements

definitions.name: O1A.FFILL
definitions.body: 'O1A.FV' BIND O1A.FV O1A.FV O1A.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NILs -> forward-filled V, leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: O1A.IDX
definitions.note: V -> Vector of its indices 0..n-1 (empty for empty)

definitions.name: O1A.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'O1A.RV' BIND O1A.RV 1 DROP O1A.IDX [ 'O1A.RI' BIND O1A.RV O1A.RI 1 ADD GET 'O1A.RB' BIND O1A.RV O1A.RI GET 'O1A.RA' BIND NIL 1 O1A.RB O1A.RB NIL? SELECT 1 O1A.RA O1A.RA NIL? SELECT DIV O1A.RA NIL? NOT O1A.RB NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: V with NILs -> Vector of V[i+1]/V[i], NIL where either is missing

definitions.name: O1A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'O1A.SV' BIND O1A.SV O1A.PRESENT 'O1A.SP' BIND O1A.SP O1A.SP 0 GET [ MAX ] FOLD 'O1A.SM' BIND O1A.SV [ 'O1A.SE' BIND NIL 1 O1A.SE O1A.SE NIL? SELECT O1A.SM DIV O1A.SE NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: V with NILs -> each present value divided by the largest present value, NILs kept

definitions.name: O1A.QTYBY
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS 'O1A.OR' BIND O1A.OR [ 'sku' GET ] MAP O1A.OR [ 'qty' GET ] MAP GROUP 'O1A.OG' BIND O1A.OG KEYS O1A.OG VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record sku -> total qty, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O1A.TOPKEY
definitions.body: 'O1A.KR' BIND O1A.KR KEYS O1A.KR VALUES -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET GET
definitions.note: Record with numeric values -> first key holding the largest value

definitions.name: O1A.TAGCOUNTS
definitions.body: G0C.ORDERS [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP [ ] [ CONCAT ] FOLD TALLY
definitions.note: orders JSON String -> Record tag -> number of orders carrying it

solutions.orders.unpriced: G0C.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
solutions.messy.title: G0D.WORDS [ LOWER G0B.TITLECASE ] MAP G0A.UNWORDS
